newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 11.

text.p: -- Falcon Drilling Co Inc and Reading & Bates Corp said their boards approved a definitive merger agreement. Falcon Drilling shareholders would get one share in the new company, R&B Falcon Corp, for each Falcon share. Reading shareholders would get 0.59 R&B Falcon share for each Reading share. Falcon's stock closed at 57-7/8, while Reading finished at 30-5/16.

-- MCI Communications Corp said it expects earnings for the second half of 1997 and into 1998 to be below Wall Street expectations due to delays in gaining entry into U.S. local phone service markets. MCI is set to merge with British Telecommunications Plc in a $24 billion deal. MCI closed at 42-3/8 in New York, then fell to 40 after the bell.
-- Atmel Corp reported second quarter earnings of $0.27 per share, down from $0.50 a year ago. The computer circuit maker's stock closed at 28-1/2, then dipped to 28 in after-hours trading.
